This website adapts the Particles (Backgrounds) and Noise (Animations)
components from the user's local React Bits checkout.

Adapted files: src/intro-particles.js and src/intro-screen.js.
Adaptations: native ES-module lifecycle, monochrome settings, pointer wake,
responsive particle density and fallback rendering. Used as part of the
PeanutMilk portfolio website, not distributed as a standalone component pack.
